apps.localizedDescription:
Nuvio Z is a free, open-source media app for your phone, desktop, and TV.

Bring your own sources. Nuvio Z turns them into a library with synchronized Watch Together, multi-provider Debrid support, artwork, ratings, subtitles, and your place saved on every screen.
